design: INDIVIDUAL 07: a tall broad-shouldered scarred veteran council elder, muscular but aged, gold-green spotted scales, heavy orbital ridges, long dark tendrils silver at their tips gathered at nape. Short dark purple sleeveless vest over an ivory pleated robe, an asymmetrical broad brass sash and four large carved rank tags. One hand holds a blunt staff with a hollow triangular top, other hand relaxed beside the hip. No battle armor or crown, experienced civic authority.
